title: Verify European compact selector catalog startup
changes: Verify the existing e112 compact selector catalog integration through production CLI startup and document its scope.
validation: Wine startup completed 12 frames; all 100 runtime resource identities matched the manifest, and guarded inputs and dataset remained unchanged. Existing create/reuse and 96 conditional reader comparisons were not repeated.

The first sandboxed Wine attempt could not create the Wine runtime directory; its diagnostics were retained and its owned leases were recovered after host process inspection. The subsequent Wine unit passed.
limitations: Catalog reads were zero: ordinary use of the three new roots and tables, global coverage, Linux, USA, native Windows and mods remain unverified. No performance or space measurements; the e111 comparison remains retained.
